items.description:
Laerskool Magalieskruin is an Afrikaans-medium primary school serving the Magalieskruin community in Pretoria. The school's guiding values are hard work, honesty, caring and respect, and its stated mission is to provide a structured developmental platform for its learners, staff, parents and the broader community through a stimulating learning environment grounded in ethical norms, effective management and ongoing monitoring and evaluation. Its vision is to be a leading, values-driven primary school that is learner-centred, helping each child reach their potential through a culture of growth and excellence.

Beyond academics, the school offers sport and cultural programmes, a Tuis Akademie home-learning component, an early-years programme called Gallie Goggas, an aftercare Naskool service, and a community service programme for learners. Prospective and current families can access school fee information, enrolment forms, staff details and a virtual tour through the school's website, and the school maintains an active presence on Facebook and YouTube.

items.description:
LBK Security Services is a South African security provider based in Amberfield Valley, offering protection services across residential, commercial, industrial and retail environments nationwide. The company positions itself as a specialist in retail loss prevention and tactical response, alongside broader security solutions, and highlights round-the-clock protection delivered by trained officers. Its core service lines include armed and unarmed guarding, VIP protection, retail loss prevention, tactical response and residential security.

LBK Security Services emphasises integrity as a core value, stating a commitment to transparent and trustworthy service for its clients, and says its officers undergo professional training to maintain consistent standards across assignments. The company also describes using modern technology to support its security operations, aiming to strengthen safety outcomes for the properties and people it protects.

Lebo Tebo Trading & Projects is a construction, civil and mechanical services company primarily based in Centurion, Pretoria, with an additional office in Taung, North West, and operations across South Africa. Founded in 2008, the company specialises in general building, civil and mechanical works alongside logistics services, and describes its mission as becoming a leading provider across these sectors nationally.

Beyond contracting work, Lebo Tebo Trading & Projects participates in socio-economic development initiatives aimed at supporting local communities, including funding bursaries for deserving students, providing food parcels to those in need, and sponsoring local sporting clubs and churches. The company states its vision is to grow alongside its affiliated companies while empowering its team, employees and the wider community through the consistent delivery of quality products and services.

items.description:
Legally Armed Centurion/Pretoria is a branch of the Legally Armed firearms administration franchise, based in Waverley, Pretoria. The branch assists sportshooters, hunters, game farm owners, professional hunters, security company owners, private firearm owners and attorneys with firearm licensing matters.

Services include new firearm licence applications, which the branch types, motivates, binds and guarantees using the relevant supporting documentation, as well as licence renewals for firearms approaching expiry. The branch also provides a dedicated service to other attorneys, assisting with applications, estate firearms matters and appeals. Competency certificate services cover individuals, collectors, applicants with previous convictions, renewals and further competency assessments, along with support for dealers, manufacturers and gunsmiths. New licence categories handled include self-defence, restricted firearms for self-defence, and both occasional and dedicated hunting and sportshooting licences, in addition to private collector applications and business licensing for security companies.

Legally Armed operates additional branches across Limpopo, Mpumalanga and KwaZulu-Natal as part of its wider franchise network.

Lehle Enterprise is a Pretoria-based business consulting firm specialising in Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment and Employment Equity advisory services. The company positions itself as a B-BBEE and EE compliance partner, offering a turnkey approach to transformation and localisation participation requirements for its clients. Its service lines include B-BBEE and Employment Equity consulting, economic development and advisory work, ATR and WSP consulting covering Annual Training Reports and Workplace Skills Plans, supplier development, and business strategy consulting. Lehle Enterprise describes its role as helping organisations prepare for the future by mitigating compliance risks and identifying available opportunities within transformation legislation.

The firm is a privately held company with a small team of between two and ten employees, operating from the Pretoria, Gauteng area. Its stated approach combines corporate strategy development with regulatory compliance work, assisting businesses in navigating South Africa's B-BBEE and Employment Equity frameworks alongside skills development planning.

LIME STUDIOS is a full-service graphic and digital design studio based in Rietondale, Pretoria, serving marketing communication needs across multiple disciplines. The studio's team includes designers, illustrators, video editors and digital technicians, allowing it to handle design and production work from concept through to completion, whether a project involves a new logo, website, video or full marketing campaign.

Its graphic design service covers logos, business cards, brochures, flyers, letterheads and email signatures, while its web design offering produces responsive websites for desktop, tablet and mobile devices, incorporating search engine optimisation to improve page ranking. LIME STUDIOS also provides web hosting, including selected hosting packages, domain registration and custom email addresses, alongside both indoor and outdoor printing services covering business cards, brochures, flyers, outdoor signs, banners and posters.

items.description:
This Midfields Estate location trades under the national Lithotech brand, which positions itself as South Africa's leading specialist in printing, supply management, marketing material, office supplies, labels and packaging. The brand operates through an experienced sales force offering customised solutions, backed by manufacturing facilities and a national warehouse infrastructure that supports comprehensive supply management for its clients. Lithotech's product and service range spans printing, supply management, marketing material, office supplies, labels and packaging, with further offerings including printed business forms and documents, printed business stationery, marketing collateral, education products, election products, integrated products and commercial products.

The brand also runs periodic promotional and seasonal initiatives, such as curated Women's Month gift ideas and an annual complimentary wall calendar for offices, schools and homes. Sustainability is described as integral to Lithotech's long-term strategy, with stated commitments to minimising environmental footprint and supporting staff and community well-being.

LJR Pump Distributors grew out of an existing family plumbing business in Pretoria, which built a reputation for reliability and quality in traditional plumbing work over a number of years. In the early 2020s, growing demand for solutions to water flow issues led the family-run business to launch LJR Pump Distributions as a dedicated division focused on pumps and water flow systems, separate from general plumbing repairs. This specialisation drew on the founding team's established plumbing expertise, applying that background knowledge to the selection and supply of pumping equipment.

The online store offers customers the option to register as a wholesale client and supports special requests and sourcing for products not held in standard stock. Information about the business and its offerings is shared through an Our Story section on the company's website, alongside standard e-commerce policies covering privacy, refunds, shipping and terms of service, and the business maintains a presence on Facebook for customer engagement.

items.description:
Lorna Real Estate is a residential, commercial and farm property agency based in Florauna, serving the area west of the Apies River and north of the Magaliesberg in Pretoria's north-west suburbs. The agency is led by a principal who has over 20 years of experience in the property industry and describes a strong personal commitment to helping clients buy or sell their homes.

Following an overseas visit to the United States in 2007, the agency's leadership recognised that significant changes were coming to the property industry and adapted its approach to doing business accordingly. As part of this shift, Lorna Real Estate began creating opportunities for younger people entering the real estate profession, employing them as property practitioners and administrators and personally training them to develop strong product knowledge and professional skills. The agency's approach is built on the belief that controlling available property stock is central to influencing the market, with services spanning residential sales, show houses, developments, commercial property and farms.

items.description:
MacBuild Raslouw is a hardware store serving homeowners, businesses and contractors across Centurion and Raslouw, operating under the MacBuild Hardware brand with more than 13 years of experience in the hardware trade. The store offers daily deliveries of building materials such as sand, stone, cement, bricks and timber, alongside practical advice from its team for DIY projects, building work and contractor jobs.

Its range is organised into seven departments: Building Materials, spanning 10 product groups; Paint & Accessories, with 13 product groups; Plumbing Supplies, across 14 product groups; Electrical, covering 8 product groups; Doors & Windows, with 8 product groups; Tools & Hardware, spanning 11 product groups; and Gardening, with 2 product groups. MacBuild Hardware says its products are selected from trusted manufacturers and suppliers to maintain reliable quality, and the business describes a focus on responsible growth through energy-efficient products, waste reduction and eco-conscious sourcing.

Marcus A Malan operates as MA Malan Attorneys & Immigration Lawyers, a law firm based in Ashley Gardens, Pretoria. The firm's practice areas, as set out on its website, include immigration law, marriage and family law, and notary public and notarial services, alongside general legal assistance across a range of matters. The firm's site also references its Fidelity Fund Certificates, a regulatory requirement for South African attorneys handling trust funds, and includes a section addressing why clients should choose MA Malan Attorneys, along with client testimonials and reviews.

The firm offers clients the option to book a consultation specifically with its immigration law specialists. Its premises in Ashley Gardens include a wheelchair accessible entrance and a wheelchair accessible parking area, making the office accessible to clients with mobility needs.

Marius Scheepers & Co is a labour law and employment law firm based in Menlyn, Pretoria. Its attorneys regularly represent clients in the Labour Court, the Labour Appeal Court, the High Court, the CCMA, Bargaining Councils and at private arbitrations, handling matters such as unfair dismissal, retrenchment and other labour disputes. The firm's contract law work covers drafting and interpreting contracts, together with assessments of a business's compliance with current labour legislation.

In collective bargaining matters, it handles dispute resolution, trade union recognition agreements, the drafting and interpretation of collective agreements, and disputes arising from protected and unprotected strikes. Its commercial law practice drafts and litigates restraint-of-trade agreements and advises on disputes between corporate board members, entity-related disputes and the winding-up of companies. The firm also assists with disciplinary hearings, offering attorneys to chair hearings, conduct misconduct investigations, prepare forensic reports, draft disciplinary charges and provide legal representation for employers and employees during the process.

items.description:
Moot Bolts & Nuts is a hardware store in Hermanstad, Pretoria, specialising in fasteners sourced from a wide range of suppliers. Alongside its core stock of bolts and nuts, the store sells tools and accessories aimed at DIY projects, together with power tools and engineering tools. It describes itself as a specialist in industrial supplies and takes requests for quotes on bulk or specific orders.

The store's product range includes brands such as Gedore, ThermaMax, Hitachi, TorkCraft, KingTony, ToolQuip & Allied and Makita, covering hand tools, power tools and engineering equipment alongside its fastener stock. Customers can approach the business directly for quotes when they need a particular product or volume that isn't listed as standard stock. The combination of fasteners, branded power tools and industrial supplies lets Moot Bolts & Nuts serve tradespeople and DIY customers in the Hermanstad and wider Pretoria area who need hardware, fixings and equipment for building and engineering projects.

N-Fitness Personal Training Studio operates from 58 Hendrik Ave in Brummeria, Pretoria, and takes bookings through the Fresha online booking platform. Its listed service categories extend beyond conventional one-on-one training to include weight loss programmes, body sculpting treatments and tattoo removal treatments, alongside personal training sessions. The studio is open Monday to Friday from 5:00 AM to 7:00 PM and Saturday from 7:00 AM to 1:00 PM, and remains closed on Sundays, giving clients early-morning and evening options around standard working hours.

Prospective clients can check available appointment times and book directly online through the studio's Fresha page rather than contacting the studio by other means. Operating as a registered health practice, the studio groups its offerings under personal training together with weight management and body contouring services, reflecting a broader scope of services than training alone.

items.description:
New Yellow Solar is a renewable energy company based in Willow Park Manor, Pretoria, offering solar systems that are custom designed for each customer rather than sold as a single standard package. Customers can buy a solar system outright, with an additional maintenance and repair service available for those who want ongoing support after installation. For customers who prefer not to pay the full cost upfront, the company offers Rent-to-own and Finance-to-own options, both structured around fixed monthly premiums, with maintenance and repairs included as part of the financing arrangement.

Alongside residential installations, the company's offering extends to commercial customers. The company positions its solar systems as a way for customers to reduce their electricity costs while lowering their environmental impact, describing its approach to sustainable energy as affordable and tailored to individual household or business needs rather than a single fixed installation for every customer.

Nkumisi Holdings (Pty) Ltd is a Pretoria-based company specialising in web design, web development and software development. Beyond building websites, the company develops custom business software built to a client's own specifications, with products including school management systems, sales management systems, accounting systems, bookkeeping systems, medical consultation systems and point-of-sale systems. Rather than offering a fixed set of templates, the company builds each digital product around the requirements the client provides, with a team of developers responsible for delivering a functional system once the specification has been agreed.

Its service offering spans the full process from initial design through to delivery of a working system, covering both the visual and technical sides of a digital product. The range of systems built, from education and retail management to medical consultation and bookkeeping, indicates the company works across multiple industries rather than focusing on a single sector, tailoring each software solution to the specific operational needs of the business commissioning it.

Nology is a value-added distributor of converged IP solutions, founded in 2001 and based in Louwlardia, Centurion. It supplies service providers, network operators, systems integrators and resellers across Southern Africa with broadband, wireless, networking and VoIP products from a range of international brands. Its product categories include consumer home Wi-Fi equipment, backup power products, media players, networking switches, security gateways, business Wi-Fi and CCTV equipment, alongside related accessories.

Beyond distribution, the company supports its reseller network with value-added services covering the selection, deployment and ongoing support of the products it supplies, and runs a reseller programme that resellers can register for online. Nology has also expanded into visual display technology, becoming a global value-added distributor for Absen LED displays, a brand that exports LED display products to more than 140 countries and is used in indoor, outdoor and professional audio-visual installations. This addition sits alongside its existing networking and connectivity product lines.

Northern Glass Group has traded as Northern Hardware & Glass since 1978, operating from Koedoespoort Industrial in Pretoria as part of a 12-branch network spanning retail, wholesale and manufacturing. The company supplies glass products ranging from frameless showers and mirrors to shopfronts, aluminium systems and safety glass, serving retail customers, trade partners and manufacturing clients across its branch network. Its product range is organised into categories including laminated glass products, toughened glass safety products, double glazing units, aluminium and hardware items, and a further range of specialised glass products.

Alongside retail and wholesale supply, the company carries out manufacturing and precision glass processing aligned to individual project requirements, supporting trade and project work in addition to walk-in retail sales. Operating across 12 branches gives the business a national reach beyond a single location, with its Pretoria branch forming part of that wider network rather than an independent standalone operation.

Nuclei Lifestyle Design is a Pretoria-based firm of architects and interior designers established in 1999, located in the Val-De-Grace area. The practice is led by an award-winning architect and covers four main areas of work: residential architecture, interior design, corporate and commercial architecture, and landscape architecture, with furniture procurement offered as an additional service. Its residential work spans new home designs, home renovations and residential interiors, while its corporate and commercial division handles corporate design and corporate interiors for business clients. On the landscape side, the practice designs gardens and outdoor spaces as part of a project rather than as a separate afterthought.

Project experience includes the renovation and upgrade of the Kilnerpark Day Hospital, where the practice's work was recognised for its continuous attention to detail and the overall standards maintained throughout the project. The firm takes on projects of varying scale, from large corporate and estate developments to smaller, more personalised residential commissions.

Nyati Paints manufactures and supplies paint from its factory in Rosslyn, an industrial area north-west of the Pretoria city centre. The present owners took ownership of the business in March 1999 and have worked since then to re-establish the Nyati Paints brand in the market. The company serves a wide client base, from homeowners redecorating a house to contractors, shop owners and factories needing industrial-grade coatings, supplying both local customers and export clients further into Africa. Its main product line consists of water-based paints, supporting a shift toward a greener, healthier environment, while it continues to manufacture standard enamel paint, primers and other solvent-based products in the traditional alkyd market for industrial and decorative use.

The factory operates Monday to Thursday from 7:30 to 16:00 and Friday from 7:30 to 15:00, closing on weekends and public holidays.

items.description:
Orange Vibrator Motor Company (OVMC) was established in November 2006 as an independent company operating from a purpose-built facility on the corner of Kitshoff Street and Helium Road in Rosslyn, outside Pretoria. The company officially represents Italvibras, described as the world leader in vibrator motor manufacturing, and Rosta, a Swiss manufacturer of suspension systems and tensioning elements. OVMC specialises in the sizing, selection and supply of vibratory motors and suspension mountings for original equipment manufacturers and end users. Its key product lines include Italvibras vibrator motors, Rosta systems and elements, and motor tension devices, and the company provides CAD downloads for both the Rosta and Italvibras ranges to support technical specification work.

The Rosslyn location was chosen to be centrally situated for serving customers in the area.

Ornics Hair & Beauty Salon operates from 21 Silwer-Eike Avenue in Heuweloord, Centurion, offering hair removal, makeup application and eyebrow threading alongside facials and eyebrow shaping. The salon is listed under the beauty salon category and takes bookings through the Fresha online scheduling platform, allowing clients to reserve an appointment ahead of a visit. Trading hours run Monday from 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM, Tuesday through Friday from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and Saturday from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, with the salon closed on Sundays.

Located within the Heuweloord suburb of Centurion, the salon serves clients seeking a combination of hair removal and beauty treatments, including eyebrow threading and shaping services alongside facials, all delivered from its Silwer-Eike Avenue premises.

Palmin Kitchens manufactures custom kitchens, built-in cupboards and bathroom vanities from its base in Centurion, South Africa, tailoring each project to the client's space, style and budget. The company combines modern manufacturing technology with hands-on craftsmanship, designing, manufacturing and finishing every piece locally rather than outsourcing production. Its product range covers kitchens, cupboards, vanities and bespoke cabinetry designs for spaces with unique requirements, delivered through a process that moves from design and planning through to on-site installation.

Palmin Kitchens positions custom design, quality workmanship and premium finishes as its core offering, supported by an experienced team and an installation process intended to be on-time and hassle-free. The business serves customers seeking tailor-made kitchen, cupboard and vanity solutions manufactured within Centurion rather than mass-produced elsewhere.

Panarottis Wonderpark operates from Shop 324 & 325 at the Wonderpark Shopping Centre on Heinrich Avenue in Karenpark, Akasia, as part of the nationwide Panarottis restaurant chain with locations across South Africa. The restaurant serves Italian-style pizzas and pastas, including Alfredo and Margherita dishes alongside a rotating specials menu. Trading hours run from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM Monday to Thursday, 9:00 AM to 10:00 PM on Friday and Saturday, and 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM on Sunday.

The venue offers a halaal menu, a liquor licence, a dedicated play area, a smoking area, Wifi access, disabled facilities and load-shedding-safe operation so service can continue during power outages. These features combine the chain's Italian menu with practical amenities for families and other customers visiting the Wonderpark Shopping Centre location in Karenpark.

Paramount Aerospace Systems, a subsidiary of the aerospace and technology company Paramount Group, operates an aircraft manufacturing facility at Wonderboom National Airport in Pretoria. In June 2021, the company announced that its Technical Aviation Academy had relocated to Wonderboom, strategically positioned next to its advanced manufacturing facility, having originally launched the academy in Polokwane.

The academy offers internationally recognised aviation courses aimed at training the next generation of African aircraft technicians, running a three-year aviation technician course split across Mechanical Technician and Avionics Technician trades. Mechanical training covers the airframe, hydraulics, piston and turbine engines, undercarriage, pneumatic systems and fuel systems, while avionics training covers aircraft instruments, electrical systems and radio equipment. Prospective students have been encouraged to register for scheduled intakes at the academy, which trains technicians for aviation careers across the African continent.

ParkerStore Pretoria has traded under the tagline Engineering Your Success Since 2007 from Unit 012/012A Calliandra Place, on the corner of Calliandra and Taaifontein Streets in Montana Park, Pretoria. The store is part of the ParkerStore Aeroport Group network, which also operates ParkerStore branches in Kempton Park, Rustenburg, Springs and Cape Town. Its product range is organised into categories including hydraulics, pneumatics, filtration, process control, electromechanical components, and fluid and gas handling equipment, alongside Baldwin Filters and Sentinel Engine Protection products.

The branch keeps operating hours of Monday to Thursday from 7:30 to 16:30 and Friday from 7:30 to 15:00. As part of the wider Aeroport Group, the Montana Park branch draws on a network of ParkerStore locations to support customers requiring Parker-brand hydraulic, pneumatic and filtration components.

items.description:
Pepla Software Solutions was founded in 2014 on the idea that code quality matters, growing from a single garage operation into a software development business based in Pretoria. The company builds, maintains and integrates bespoke software, combining technical expertise with a close understanding of each client's project requirements. Its services span custom software built from the ground up, web development for responsive applications, UX/UI design and native and cross-platform app development.

Pepla also offers AI automation powered by large language models to streamline call centres, voice workflows and document processing, alongside reliable cloud hosting with built-in monitoring and support. For clients needing extra capacity, the company provides team augmentation, embedding developers and technical experts within existing teams, and consulting covering business analysis, system design and process engineering work.

Permasize Investments (PTY) Ltd is a business consultancy and investment management company based in Centurion, drawing on a team of business professionals spread across various industries to deliver its advisory work. The company's key business areas span business development and management, general business consultancy, information technology, oil and gas services, accounting and payroll services, and property development and management.

Its approach centres on collaboration between clients and professionals, treating networking as a tool for working together more effectively and building what the company describes as multiple forms of wealth for the people it works with. Permasize frames profitability as a function of productivity combined with effective management, and positions interaction between people as a necessary part of generating good ideas and genuine innovation within the businesses it advises.

This Pick n Pay operates as a neighbourhood grocery store within Irene Village Mall in Irene Farm Villages, Centurion, trading alongside other stores in the mall including Woolworths. The store offers fresh produce, a bakery and a variety of meats, with services that include in-store pickup, delivery for off-site orders, and same-day delivery for customers who cannot collect in person. Credit card payments are accepted at the till, and the store provides a wheelchair accessible entrance and a wheelchair accessible parking lot for customers with mobility needs.

As the grocery anchor within Irene Village Mall, the store serves shoppers across Irene Farm Villages and the surrounding Centurion area, combining everyday grocery essentials with the convenience of pickup and delivery options for those unable to shop in person.

Pistorius Scheepers Attorneys Inc, founded in 2019, operates from Persequor Technopark at 5 De Havilland Crescent in Pretoria as what the firm describes as a dynamic and progressive legal practice serving clients both locally and internationally. The firm's practice areas span property law, labour law, family law, general litigation and dispute resolution, debt collection, commercial and corporate law, legal cost consulting services, and deceased estates, trusts and fiduciary services, along with correspondent instructions for other firms.

Its stated vision is to become a trusted leader in the legal profession, setting standards for excellence, integrity and innovation, while its mission centres on delivering legal services with professionalism and precision tailored to each client's circumstances. Since its establishment, the firm has grown into what it describes as a highly regarded legal practice, built around protecting client rights, resolving disputes and providing strategic legal guidance across its range of practice areas.
